## 11 · Channel: Telegram

A thin adapter — transport only. It polls because a localhost n8n cannot receive Telegram's push webhook, and it holds the update offset in workflow static data.

**Set `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` in the environment and activate exactly ONE workflow per bot token.** Two active pollers on one token means every customer gets two replies and every message is processed twice.

The `user_key` is `telegram:<chat id>`, so memory and bookings are scoped per channel: the same person on another channel is a different conversation.
